summary:
Public Law 118-130, the "Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2024" (enacted November 25, 2024, from H.R. 7777), directs a cost-of-living increase in the rates of veterans' disability compensation and dependency and indemnity compensation (DIC), effective December 1, 2024.

Section 1 provides the short title (codified as a note to 38 U.S.C. 101).

Section 2(a) (set out as a note to 38 U.S.C. 1114) requires the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to increase, effective December 1, 2024, the dollar amounts in effect on November 30, 2024, for payment of disability compensation and DIC under the provisions enumerated in subsection (b), in accordance with the method prescribed in subsection (c).

Section 2(b) specifies the amounts subject to increase: (1) each dollar amount for wartime disability compensation under 38 U.S.C. 1114; (2) each dollar amount for additional compensation for dependents under 38 U.S.C. 1115(1); (3) the clothing allowance under 38 U.S.C. 1162; (4) each dollar amount for DIC to surviving spouses under subsections (a) through (d) of 38 U.S.C. 1311; and (5) each dollar amount for DIC to children under 38 U.S.C. 1313(a) and 1314.

Section 2(c) prescribes the mechanism for the increase: each enumerated amount is to be increased by the same percentage as the increase in Social Security benefit amounts payable under Title II of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 401 et seq.) effective December 1, 2024, as determined under section 215(i) of that Act (42 U.S.C. 415(i)). The COLA is thus tethered to the Social Security automatic-adjustment determination rather than fixed by a statutorily stated percentage.

Section 2(d) (also a note to 38 U.S.C. 1114) authorizes the Secretary to administratively adjust, consistent with the subsection (a) increases, the rates of disability compensation payable to persons under section 10 of Public Law 85-857 (72 Stat. 1263) who have not received compensation under chapter 11 of title 38.

Section 3 (a note to 38 U.S.C. 1114) requires the Secretary to publish in the Federal Register the amounts specified in section 2(b), as increased, not later than the date on which the corresponding Social Security matters under section 215(i)(2)(D) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 415(i)(2)(D)) must be published pursuant to a section 215(i) determination made during fiscal year 2025.

The Act amends no statutory text directly, operating through freestanding directives set out as statutory notes; it contains no appropriation and no sunset provision.
